title: Making a connection at a conference
objectives: Start with specific feedback on the talk
Share a relevant connection and ask a question
Ask to exchange contacts for a follow-up

courseTemplate.setting: The attendee works in education. The speaker's team reduced latency using caching.

roles.learner: A conference attendee working in education
roles.partner: A speaker who has just demoed a product

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi! Did you get a chance to see the keynote?

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, the demo was impressive. I liked how quickly the first answer appeared.
targetPatterns.example: Yes, the demo was impressive. I liked how quickly the first answer appeared.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm working on something similar in education. How did you reduce latency?
targetPatterns.example: I'm working on something similar in education. How did you reduce latency?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we exchange contacts? I'd love to follow up next week.
targetPatterns.example: Could we exchange contacts? I'd love to follow up next week.

targetPatterns.pattern: What brings you to this conference?
targetPatterns.example: What brings you to this conference?
targetPatterns.translation: 什么风把您吹到这个大会？

targetPatterns.pattern: What does your company do, in a nutshell?
targetPatterns.example: What does your company do, in a nutshell?
targetPatterns.translation: 简单说，贵公司是做什么的？

targetPatterns.pattern: I loved your talk on AI agents.
targetPatterns.example: I loved your talk on AI agents.
targetPatterns.translation: 很喜欢您关于 AI Agent 的分享。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I connect with you on LinkedIn?
targetPatterns.example: Could I connect with you on LinkedIn?
targetPatterns.translation: 可以在 LinkedIn 上互关吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Let me introduce you to our tech lead.
targetPatterns.example: Let me introduce you to our tech lead.
targetPatterns.translation: 我介绍您认识我们的技术负责人。

targetPatterns.pattern: Are you working on anything exciting right now?
targetPatterns.example: Are you working on anything exciting right now?
targetPatterns.translation: 最近在做什么有意思的项目吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Would you be open to a quick coffee chat sometime?
targetPatterns.example: Would you be open to a quick coffee chat sometime?
targetPatterns.translation: 方便找时间喝杯咖啡聊聊吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll follow up with an email this week.
targetPatterns.example: I'll follow up with an email this week.

stages.title: Start with specific feedback on the talk
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi! Did you get a chance to see the keynote?”
successCriteria: The learner can start with specific feedback on the talk in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, the demo was …”

stages.title: Share a relevant connection and ask a question
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Thanks! Improving response time took a lot of work.”
successCriteria: The learner can share a relevant connection and ask a question in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm working on something …”

stages.title: Ask to exchange contacts for a follow-up
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Caching made the biggest difference. I'd be happy to tell you more sometime.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask to exchange contacts for a follow-up in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could we exchange contacts? …”

languageNotes: 要联系方式别说 "Give me your WeChat"，用 Could I connect with you...；活动上的寒暄从「对方」切入（他们的演讲、公司）比讲自己更受欢迎。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 什么风把您吹到这个大会？
warmup.suggestedAnswer: What brings you to this conference?

modelDialogue.text: Hi! Did you get a chance to see the keynote?
Yes, the demo was impressive. I liked how quickly the first answer appeared.
Thanks! Improving response time took a lot of work.
I'm working on something similar in education. How did you reduce latency?
Caching made the biggest difference. I'd be happy to tell you more sometime.
Could we exchange contacts? I'd love to follow up next week.
